public_rationale: Contemporary studies document recurring spatial-consistency and multistep-reasoning failures, while model reports acknowledge persistent factual errors. Training data had also grown and been refined. This supports the ordinary reading that substantial difficulties remained. Documented improvements prevent extending that finding into a claim that scaling achieved nothing or that generative AI lacked every relevant capability.
limitations: The severity term is qualitative, so the outcome depends partly on the stated reading.
Evidence covers selected models and tasks, not every generative system.
The assessment concerns capabilities before the post, not their status in 2026.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI has struggled mightily with world models, high-level reasoning and factuality, even with ever more data.

statement.excerpt: Gary Marcus is astonished that some people still haven’t recognized that generative AI has struggled mightily when it comes to world models, high level reasoning and factuality, even as evidence for that conclusion continues to pour in, even with data of ever-greater magnitude and sophistication..

from_speaker: world models, high level reasoning and factuality
even with data of ever-greater magnitude and sophistication
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that substantial, repeatable difficulties remained across these capabilities despite growth and refinement in training data.
The claim allows substantial improvements and successful tasks; it does not say that every model always fails or that scaling provides no benefit.
World-model difficulties include failures to represent ordinary objects and spatial relationships coherently; high-level reasoning includes composing multiple steps correctly.
This is a retrospective observation through February 17, 2024. No starting date is supplied, so the target period has an open beginning.
Despite more data describes coexistence, not a controlled causal claim that additional data cannot help.
criteria.support_condition: Evaluations available for the historical period document substantial recurring failures in world consistency, multistep reasoning, and factuality, alongside evidence of increased or refined training data.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad, credible evaluations establish that the specified difficulties had been substantially overcome across representative generative systems by publication.

evidence.explanation: Experiments on multiplication, logic puzzles, and dynamic programming document sharply worsening performance with task complexity. These are repeatable multistep reasoning difficulties, rather than isolated anecdotes.

evidence.locator: Appendix A.4.8; training changes in sections 1–2; limitations in section 5.2
evidence.explanation: The report documents 40% more pretraining tokens, revised data selection, and remaining hallucination risks. It also reports improvements, which limit any interpretation that greater scale or refinement brought no benefit.
OpenAI acknowledges continuing factual and reasoning errors in GPT-4. The same section reports improved factuality relative to GPT-3.5, showing that persistent limitations coexisted with progress.
